content:
Free hearing aids are being offered to Nuevo Laredo residents with hearing loss, with registration open now through Wednesday, November 19, according to El Mañana.

The campaign is run by Patrimonio de la Beneficencia Pública de Tamaulipas in coordination with the Sistema DIF Nuevo Laredo, El Mañana reported.

Residents with hearing problems who need a hearing aid can register weekdays from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m. at the Distrito de Salud para el Bienestar V, located at Blvd. Manuel Ávila Camacho 2632 in Colonia La Fe. The hearing aids are expected to be delivered in approximately March 2027, with the exact date to be confirmed.

Applicants need to bring a copy of their INE voter ID, a copy of their CURP, and proof of address, such as a water or electricity bill, according to El Mañana.

Patrimonio coordinator Víctor Yunuel Martínez Zúñiga said the aim is for the support to reach more people who need it, and that the registration period is open for the entire community, El Mañana reported.

Sources: El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo, November 9, 2026.
